text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen takes the spring shield!
She's
proven herself a worthy member of
her
prestigious family!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I didn't even come close! How is she so
much
better than me?!)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's McQueen for you! She took all
that
pressure in stride and realized the
Mejiro family's
ambitions!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
But what about Ryan? I suppose this
means
McQueen's going to be the one
to guide the
Mejiro family forward...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I may have lost today, but next time, the
glory's
mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen isn't the only runner in the
Mejiro
family! And at the Takarazuka
Kinen, I, Mejiro
Ryan, will show you that
I'm not to be ignored!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! That's right! I'll always be
rooting for you,
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(And here I was feeling all sorry for
myself... I
didn't even think about my
fans.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(But Ryan's different. She heard her fans'
voices
and put them at ease right away.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Now that's someone who's lived
shouldering
expectations. That's what
separates me and her...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! At the
Takarazuka Kinen,
that's gonna be me!
